_comment: Ground truth for the correctness-lens calibration fixtures.
It lives HERE and not inside the .diff files on purpose: the diff is fed to the
lens verbatim, so any answer written into it would leak the label.
`expect` is the verdict a competent reviewer must give. `truth` is the one-sentence
justification — if it cannot be written confidently, the fixture is a coin flip and
does not belong in this directory (ADR-0008).
scripts/calibrate.ts refuses to run if a .diff here is missing from this list.

fixtures.truth: It deletes the only guard between `db.findUser` returning null and `user.email`, so a missing user becomes a TypeError instead of a NotFoundError.
It adds the missing null guard before dereferencing `user`, which is the fix for the bug `known-bad.diff` introduces.
`refreshing` is only cleared on the success path, so a single failed refresh leaves a rejected promise parked in it and every later call rethrows that same failure forever.
The in-flight promise is cleared in `finally`, so a failed refresh rejects the callers waiting on it and the next call starts a fresh attempt.
`hi = mid - 1` drops `mid` from the search range even when `sorted[mid]` is itself the first element >= target, so `lowerBound([1, 3], 3)` returns 0 instead of 1.

The half-open upper bound `sorted.length` is correct for a `lo < hi` / `hi = mid` loop — it is never used as an index, and it is what lets a target above every element return `sorted.length` as documented.
`!override` is also true for `0`, so an account explicitly capped at zero spend silently gets the $100 default cap instead.
`== null` matches exactly `null` and `undefined`, so the guard strictly widens and removes a real `null.trim()` crash; the loose equality looks like a defect but is the idiomatic nullish check.
The catch absorbs every write failure while the function still returns `true`, so callers are told a draft was durably persisted when it was not.
Only `NotFoundError` is absorbed, and it already satisfies the documented idempotent post-condition; every other error is rethrown unchanged.
